# filedelete

Deletes a file.

```ttl
filedelete <filename>
```

## Remarks

Deletes the file specified by &lt;filename&gt;.
If the file is deleted successfully, the system variable "result" is set to 0. Otherwise, "result" is set to non-zero.

## Example

```ttl
filedelete 'temp.log'
```
